content: The unexamined life is not worth living for a human being.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Ho de anexetastos bios ou biotos anthropoi — Socrates (Plato's Apology 38a)
explanation: To simply wake up, chase biological urges, consume food, accumulate paper wealth, and collapse into sleep without ever asking why you exist, what virtue demands, or how you ought to live is to reduce human consciousness to the level of cattle. Question your life.
practicalInsight: Turn off all music and media during your commute today. Sit with your own thoughts and examine your motives.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you critically questioned the underlying values and assumptions driving your daily schedule?
